verses.original: וְהָ֣אָדָ֔ם יָדַ֖ע אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ חַוָּ֣ה וַתַּ֙הַר֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־ קַ֔יִן אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ קָנִ֥יתִי אִ֖ישׁ וַתֹּ֕אמֶר
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·ḏām yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw ḥaw·wāh wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ ’eṯ- qa·yin ’eṯ- Yah·weh qā·nî·ṯî ’îš wat·tō·mer
verses.literal: And Adam had relations with - his wife Eve and she conceived and gave birth to - Cain With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man she said

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣סֶף לָלֶ֔דֶת אֶת־ אָחִ֖יו אֶת־ הָ֑בֶל וַֽיְהִי־ הֶ֙בֶל֙ הָיָ֖ה רֹ֣עֵה צֹ֔אן וְקַ֕יִן עֹבֵ֥ד אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·sep̄ lā·le·ḏeṯ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw ’eṯ- hā·ḇel way·hî- he·ḇel hā·yāh rō·‘êh ṣōn wə·qa·yin ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Later she gave birth - to [Cain’s] brother - Abel Now Abel was a keeper of sheep while Cain was a tiller of the soil

verses.original: מִקֵּ֣ץ יָמִ֑ים וַֽיְהִ֖י קַ֜יִן וַיָּבֵ֨א מִפְּרִ֧י הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: miq·qêṣ yā·mîm way·hî qa·yin way·yā·ḇê mip·pə·rî hā·’ă·ḏā·māh min·ḥāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: So in the course of time - Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD

verses.original: וְהֶ֨בֶל ה֛וּא גַם־ הֵבִ֥יא וּמֵֽחֶלְבֵהֶ֑ן מִבְּכֹר֥וֹת צֹאנ֖וֹ יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּ֣שַׁע אֶל־ הֶ֖בֶל וְאֶל־ מִנְחָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·ḇel hū ḡam- hê·ḇî ū·mê·ḥel·ḇê·hen mib·bə·ḵō·rō·wṯ ṣō·nōw Yah·weh way·yi·ša‘ ’el- he·ḇel wə·’el- min·ḥā·ṯōw
verses.literal: while Abel . . . - brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock And the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering

verses.original: וְאֶל־ לֹ֣א שָׁעָ֑ה וְאֶל־ קַ֥יִן מִנְחָת֖וֹ לְקַ֙יִן֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיִּ֤חַר פָּנָֽיו׃ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- lō šā·‘āh wə·’el- qa·yin min·ḥā·ṯōw lə·qa·yin mə·’ōḏ way·yi·ḥar pā·nāw way·yip·pə·lū
verses.literal: but He had no regard for Cain and his offering So Cain became very angry and his countenance fell

verses.original: לָ֚מָּה חָ֣רָה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ קָ֑יִן לָ֔ךְ וְלָ֖מָּה פָנֶֽיךָ׃ נָפְל֥וּ
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ḥā·rāh way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- qā·yin lāḵ wə·lām·māh p̄ā·ne·ḵā nā·p̄ə·lū
verses.literal: Why are you angry said the LORD to Cain - and why has your countenance fallen

verses.original: אִם־ תֵּיטִיב֙ הֲל֤וֹא לֹ֣א שְׂאֵ֔ת וְאִם֙ תֵיטִ֔יב חַטָּ֣את רֹבֵ֑ץ לַפֶּ֖תַח תְּשׁ֣וּקָת֔וֹ וְאֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּמְשָׁל־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tê·ṭîḇ hă·lō·w lō śə·’êṯ wə·’im ṯê·ṭîḇ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ rō·ḇêṣ lap·pe·ṯaḥ tə·šū·qā·ṯōw wə·’ê·le·ḵā wə·’at·tāh tim·šāl- bōw
verses.literal: If you do what is right {will} you not be accepted But if you refuse to do what is right sin is crouching at your door it desires you but you must master it

verses.original: קַ֖יִן וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ אָחִ֑יו הֶ֣בֶל וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּהְיוֹתָ֣ם בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה קַ֛יִן וַיָּ֥קָם אֶל־ אָחִ֖יו הֶ֥בֶל וַיַּהַרְגֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qa·yin way·yō·mer ’el- ’ā·ḥîw he·ḇel way·hî bih·yō·w·ṯām baś·śā·ḏeh qa·yin way·yā·qām ’el- ’ā·ḥîw he·ḇel way·ya·har·ḡê·hū
verses.literal: Then Cain said to his brother Abel, [“Let us go out to the field.”] And while they were in the field Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ קַ֔יִן אֵ֖י אָחִ֑יךָ הֶ֣בֶל לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אָנֹֽכִי׃ אָחִ֖י הֲשֹׁמֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- qa·yin ’ê ’ā·ḥî·ḵā he·ḇel lō yā·ḏa‘·tî way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·ḥî hă·šō·mêr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Cain Where [is] your brother Abel I do not know he answered {Am} I my brother’s keeper

verses.original: מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר ק֚וֹל אָחִ֔יךָ דְּמֵ֣י צֹעֲקִ֥ים אֵלַ֖י מִן־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: meh ‘ā·śî·ṯā way·yō·mer qō·wl ’ā·ḥî·ḵā də·mê ṣō·‘ă·qîm ’ê·lay min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: What have you done replied [the LORD] The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אָ֑תָּה אָר֣וּר מִן־ הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּצְתָ֣ה אֶת־ פִּ֔יהָ לָקַ֛חַת אֶת־ אָחִ֖יךָ דְּמֵ֥י מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’āt·tāh ’ā·rūr min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer pā·ṣə·ṯāh ’eṯ- pî·hā lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥî·ḵā də·mê mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Now you [are] cursed and banished from the ground which has opened - its mouth to receive - your brother’s blood from your hand

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹֽא־ תֹסֵ֥ף תֵּת־ כֹּחָ֖הּ לָ֑ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה נָ֥ע וָנָ֖ד בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯa·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh lō- ṯō·sêp̄ têṯ- kō·ḥāh lāḵ tih·yeh nā‘ wā·nāḏ ḇā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: When you till - the ground {it will} no longer yield its produce to you You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth

verses.original: קַ֖יִן וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה עֲוֺנִ֖י גָּד֥וֹל מִנְּשֹֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: qa·yin way·yō·mer ’el- Yah·weh ‘ă·wō·nî gā·ḏō·wl min·nə·śō
verses.literal: But Cain said to the LORD My punishment [is] greater than I can bear

verses.original: הֵן֩ אֹתִ֜י הַיּ֗וֹם גֵּרַ֨שְׁתָּ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵעַל֙ וּמִפָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶסָּתֵ֑ר וְהָיִ֜יתִי נָ֤ע וָנָד֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה כָל־ מֹצְאִ֖י יַֽהַרְגֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’ō·ṯî hay·yō·wm gê·raš·tā pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh mê·‘al ū·mip·pā·ne·ḵā ’es·sā·ṯêr wə·hā·yî·ṯî nā‘ wā·nāḏ bā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·yāh ḵāl mō·ṣə·’î ya·har·ḡê·nî
verses.literal: Behold this day You have driven me from the face of the earth and from Your face I will be hidden I {will} be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth and whoever finds me {will} kill me

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה ל֣וֹ כָּל־ הֹרֵ֣ג קַ֔יִן יֻקָּ֑ם שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יְהוָ֤ה וַיָּ֨שֶׂם א֔וֹת לְקַ֙יִן֙ לְבִלְתִּ֥י כָּל־ מֹצְאֽוֹ׃ הַכּוֹת־ אֹת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên way·yō·mer Yah·weh lōw kāl- hō·rêḡ qa·yin yuq·qām šiḇ·‘ā·ṯa·yim Yah·weh way·yā·śem ’ō·wṯ lə·qa·yin lə·ḇil·tî kāl- mō·ṣə·’ōw hak·kō·wṯ- ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Not so replied the LORD - If anyone slays Cain [then Cain] will be avenged sevenfold And the LORD placed a mark on Cain so that no one . . . who found him would kill him

verses.original: קַ֖יִן וַיֵּ֥צֵא מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ נ֖וֹד קִדְמַת־ עֵֽדֶן׃
verses.transliteration: qa·yin way·yê·ṣê mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yê·šeḇ bə·’e·reṣ- nō·wḏ qiḏ·maṯ- ‘ê·ḏen
verses.literal: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod east of Eden

verses.original: קַ֙יִן֙ אֶת־ וַיֵּ֤דַע אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־ חֲנ֑וֹךְ וַֽיְהִי֙ בֹּ֣נֶה עִ֔יר וַיִּקְרָא֙ שֵׁ֣ם הָעִ֔יר כְּשֵׁ֖ם בְּנ֥וֹ חֲנֽוֹךְ׃
verses.transliteration: qa·yin ’eṯ- way·yê·ḏa‘ ’iš·tōw wat·ta·har wat·tê·leḏ ’eṯ- ḥă·nō·wḵ way·hî bō·neh ‘îr way·yiq·rā šêm hā·‘îr kə·šêm bə·nōw ḥă·nō·wḵ
verses.literal: And Cain - had relations with his wife and she conceived and gave birth to - Enoch Then [Cain] built a city and named . . . [it] after his son Enoch

verses.original: לַֽחֲנוֹךְ֙ אֶת־ וַיִּוָּלֵ֤ד עִירָ֔ד וְעִירָ֕ד יָלַ֖ד אֶת־ מְחֽוּיָאֵ֑ל וּמְחִיּיָאֵ֗ל יָלַד֙ אֶת־ מְת֣וּשָׁאֵ֔ל וּמְתוּשָׁאֵ֖ל יָלַ֥ד אֶת־ לָֽמֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: la·ḥă·nō·wḵ ’eṯ- way·yiw·wā·lêḏ ‘î·rāḏ wə·‘î·rāḏ yā·laḏ ’eṯ- mə·ḥū·yā·’êl ū·mə·ḥî·y·yā·’êl yā·laḏ ’eṯ- mə·ṯū·šā·’êl ū·mə·ṯū·šā·’êl yā·laḏ ’eṯ- lā·meḵ
verses.literal: Now to Enoch - was born Irad and Irad was the father of - Mehujael and Mehujael was the father of - Methusael and Methusael was the father of - Lamech

verses.original: לֶ֖מֶךְ וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֥וֹ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים הָֽאַחַת֙ שֵׁ֤ם עָדָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית צִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: le·meḵ way·yiq·qaḥ- lōw šə·tê nā·šîm hā·’a·ḥaṯ šêm ‘ā·ḏāh wə·šêm haš·šê·nîṯ ṣil·lāh
verses.literal: And Lamech married . . . two women one named Adah and the other Zillah

verses.original: עָדָ֖ה אֶת־ וַתֵּ֥לֶד יָבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י יֹשֵׁ֥ב אֹ֖הֶל וּמִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḏāh ’eṯ- wat·tê·leḏ yā·ḇāl hū hā·yāh ’ă·ḇî yō·šêḇ ’ō·hel ū·miq·neh
verses.literal: Adah - gave birth to Jabal he was the father of those who dwell in tents and [raise] livestock

verses.original: אָחִ֖יו וְשֵׁ֥ם יוּבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י כָּל־ תֹּפֵ֥שׂ כִּנּ֖וֹר וְעוּגָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥîw wə·šêm yū·ḇāl hū hā·yāh ’ă·ḇî kāl- tō·p̄êś kin·nō·wr wə·‘ū·ḡāḇ
verses.literal: And his brother’s name [was] Jubal he was the father of all who play the harp and flute

verses.original: וְצִלָּ֣ה הִ֗וא גַם־ יָֽלְדָה֙ אֶת־ תּ֣וּבַל קַ֔יִן לֹטֵ֕שׁ כָּל־ חֹרֵ֥שׁ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֑ל וַֽאֲח֥וֹת תּֽוּבַל־ קַ֖יִן נַֽעֲמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣil·lāh hî ḡam- yā·lə·ḏāh ’eṯ- tū·ḇal qa·yin lō·ṭêš kāl- ḥō·rêš nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇar·zel wa·’ă·ḥō·wṯ tū·ḇal- qa·yin na·‘ă·māh
verses.literal: And Zillah . . . . . . gave birth to - vvv Tubal-cain a forger of every implement of bronze and iron And the sister vvv of Tubal-cain [was] Naamah

verses.original: לֶ֜מֶךְ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְנָשָׁ֗יו עָדָ֤ה וְצִלָּה֙ שְׁמַ֣עַן קוֹלִ֔י נְשֵׁ֣י לֶ֔מֶךְ הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּ֣י אִ֤ישׁ הָרַ֙גְתִּי֙ לְפִצְעִ֔י וְיֶ֖לֶד לְחַבֻּרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: le·meḵ way·yō·mer lə·nā·šāw ‘ā·ḏāh wə·ṣil·lāh šə·ma·‘an qō·w·lî nə·šê le·meḵ ha’·zên·nāh ’im·rā·ṯî kî ’îš hā·raḡ·tî lə·p̄iṣ·‘î wə·ye·leḏ lə·ḥab·bu·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Then Lamech said to his wives Adah and Zillah hear my voice wives of Lamech listen to my speech For I have slain [a man] for wounding me a young man for striking me

verses.original: כִּ֥י קָ֑יִן יֻקַּם־ שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם וְלֶ֖מֶךְ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî qā·yin yuq·qam- šiḇ·‘ā·ṯa·yim wə·le·meḵ šiḇ·‘îm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: If Cain is avenged sevenfold then Lamech vvv seventy-sevenfold

verses.original: אָדָ֥ם עוֹד֙ וַיֵּ֨דַע אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ אֶת־ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵׁ֑ת כִּ֣י אֱלֹהִים֙ שָֽׁת־ לִ֤י אַחֵ֔ר זֶ֣רַע תַּ֣חַת הֶ֔בֶל כִּ֥י קָֽיִן׃ הֲרָג֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām ‘ō·wḏ way·yê·ḏa‘ ’iš·tōw ’eṯ- wat·tê·leḏ bên wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw šêṯ kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm šāṯ- lî ’a·ḥêr ze·ra‘ ta·ḥaṯ he·ḇel kî qā·yin hă·rā·ḡōw
verses.literal: And Adam again had relations with his wife - and she gave birth to a son and named - him Seth saying God has granted me another seed in place of Abel since Cain killed him

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֤ת הוּא֙ גַּם־ בֵּ֔ן יֻלַּד־ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱנ֑וֹשׁ אָ֣ז הוּחַ֔ל לִקְרֹ֖א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šêṯ hū gam- bên yul·laḏ- way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw ’ĕ·nō·wōš ’āz hū·ḥal liq·rō bə·šêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: And to Seth . . . also a son was born and he called - him Enosh At that time [men] began to call upon the name of the LORD
